units.translation: they say to leave because of
⟦1⟧ must be a sentence apposition like the corresponding ⟦2⟧, and like (in a passive sentence) ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧; this, like ⟦5⟧, means "new bloodshed," cf. there before ⟦6⟧. Murder is atoned for by murder.

Here the difficulties are greatest. The manuscript has at the beginning ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧; this can also be -⟦3⟧, and the singular is recommended by the following ⟦4⟧. We can also, without violence, construct neither ⟦5⟧ nor -⟦6⟧ (Burges); but Doederlein writes ⟦7⟧, and ⟦8⟧ and ⟦9⟧ (this only ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧ in dactylic verse as here) are the same in Aeschylus, and ⟦12⟧ after ⟦13⟧ is not in the least objectionable. The ⟦14⟧ is understandable, even if unnecessary; for they are not now introducing themselves. But another objection is greater: the Eumenides want to take this care of vengeance away from the gods, especially Zeus, but constantly and not in a single case; but that is expressed by ⟦15⟧ and not ⟦16⟧, which indicates the one-time act, and this act of ⟦17⟧ necessarily lies before us as having happened; therefore ⟦18⟧ must be a participle of the past, and the present ⟦19⟧ is wrong. From this the construction already follows: ⟦20⟧ . . ⟦21⟧ . . ⟦22⟧ . . ⟦23⟧ . . ⟦24⟧ (cf. for the dative ⟦25⟧, ⟦26⟧ ⟦27⟧, similarly ⟦28⟧, ⟦29⟧ etc., Kühner-Gerth I, 424 f.). That is, our ancient office is also confirmed by Zeus in the new world. In detail: ⟦30⟧ here with double accusative, which is unprecedented for the active; if one writes instead ⟦31⟧, then the parallels are there (Kühner-Gerth I, 328f.): ⟦32⟧ ⟦33⟧ (cf. 7, 1, 44), i.e. release yourself from them, exactly as here. The ⟦34⟧ sounds somewhat mystical, but need not be meant so; Pauw's change to ⟦35⟧ is unnecessary.
but to you, glad, the many-colored night will hide the light
but I take away battles and wars from you

⟦1⟧ is a word very popular with Aeschylus (in the Eumenides also 950, 959); with ⟦2⟧ it could mean "to bring about," if only ⟦3⟧ could be construed with it. So one must write ⟦4⟧, to which ⟦5⟧ is added in the same way as to the main clause ⟦6⟧.
